explanation: A pagan prophet who was hired by Balak, the king of Moab, to curse the people of Israel, but ended up blessing them instead.
The king of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel, but failed in his attempt.
A positive statement or action from God or humans that brings happiness, success, and prosperity to the recipient.
A negative statement or action from God or humans that brings misfortune, defeat, and suffering to the recipient.
A holy act in which animals, food, or other items are offered to God as a form of worship, gratitude, or atonement for sins.
Descendants of the patriarch Jacob (also called Israel) and his twelve sons, who formed the twelve tribes of Israel.
